notes: Bibliographic metadata is checked against the official PMLR proceedings record; this establishes publication details, not algorithmic performance.

claim: C51 models the categorical distribution of discounted returns using 51 fixed atoms, applies distributional Bellman targets and projects to fixed support.
notes: The fixed 51-atom categorical support and projection steps describe the original C51 method; distinguish this from later distributional RL variants.

claim: The paper distinguishes contraction in distributional policy evaluation from non-contraction issues in control under the distributional metric.
notes: The theoretical statement is scoped to the paper's distributional policy-evaluation and control results; do not generalize the contraction claim to all control settings.
